content.comment_body: Hello, How can you make sure the lamp is always on, but can also be switched off with a push button, and do this without using a timer or clock function?
Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. Please note that this is an English-speaking forum; kindly post your next message in English. Thank you.
The main issue isn't about switching; it's that LEDs draw a high current when switched on.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants a method to keep a lamp constantly on but be able to turn it off with a push button, without using any timer function. The discussion shifts partially to concerns about LED hardware and their initial current draw, with no clear step-by-step advice provided for achieving the requested automation, indicating incomplete assistance for a basic setup.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects a simple way to configure a lamp so that it stays on by default but can be switched off with a push button, without relying on any timing or clock functions.
